pitches.logline: Me, driving home at night, wants to know if the engine lamp means stop now, but a cocky friend on the speaker says drive on.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: the claim already up over me slumped beside the big amber engine lamp as it blinks; the engine sputters and the friend calls.

pitches.logline: Me thinks a lit engine lamp is just a lamp, until a neighbour laughs at me and the same lamp turns into a second, far worse signal.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: KeywordLift, one lamp lifted huge over the amber lamp as it lights, then it splits into steady and blinking.
pitches.heroObject: the engine lamp on the cluster

pitches.logline: Me panics at a steady engine lamp and rushes to an uncle sure it will cost a fortune, but the twist is a fuel cap; the real lesson comes when it flashes.
pitches.hook: Frame 0: ResultFirst, a greyscale fuel cap with an ink arrow, the cap clicks shut and the uncle laughs off screen.

treatment.logline: Me, on the road to Mtskheta, wants to know if the engine lamp means stop now, but a cocky friend on the phone calls me a coward and says drive on.
treatment.hero: Me, a young man in a charcoal bomber over a white tee, short curls, as a profile silhouette; the same amber engine lamp all film.
treatment.obstacle: A friend who calls me a coward for slowing down, and a lamp that says nothing about why.

hook.event: The engine lamp starts to blink on the dash as the engine sputters, and the friend's call comes in calling me a coward.

act1: The lamp lights on the dash, frozen mid-blink.
The engine sputters under it and the friend calls.
The friend texts and calls me a coward; the picture goes dark into the hold.
treatment.turn: Near-silence and dark, then the drop: the word slammed over me, upright and lit.

reveal.what: The steady lamp over a flat trace: a warning, the car still drives, find the cause.

screens.step: the scanned car's result in Georgian, flashing means stop

treatment.payoff: The same me, calm, the phone in hand, the two lamps beside: one ticked, one stopped. The line: I saved the catalyst.
treatment.signature: V136LampTwo: one lamp over a trace, flat while steady, spiking while flashing; the spike runs into a cylinder that does not burn and on into a honeycomb heating red.
